runtime_adaptations: Native open_spreadsheet.py source is executed with isolated ephemeral UNO port and separate per-check LibreOffice profile; numerical computation, iteration count100 and epsilon0.0001 are unchanged.
Private original/golden and actor output are copied into verifier scratch before recalculation; no actor artifact is mutated.
External interpreter/UNO/infrastructure failures yield measured:false, no score. Native completed workbook mismatch or missing output keeps native zero.
Only Debugging, Financial_Model and Template are included. Visualization is not represented.
